`solve_model` still starts from `n.snapshots`, and `_as_model_snapshots` only flattens a MultiIndex when the existing model is detected as flat. If a model is built with ordinary single-level snapshots and the network’s snapshots are subsequently changed to a MultiIndex before calling `solve_model`, the callback receives that MultiIndex unchanged, not the model’s original representation. Thus the conversion does not guarantee the criterion for every network and call path.
